Subject: Qin Che, the Bastion Vanguard (秦彻，壁垒先锋), a mature East Asian man about 35 with an imposing sturdy build, square jaw, short cropped black hair and a small old eyebrow scar. His expression is calm, alert and protective. He intercepts danger to guard teammates. Wear worn dark gunmetal tactical plate armor with broad shield-like shoulder plates and a deep desaturated red neck wrap. Subtle rubbed bronze hardware, restrained dull blue protective rune seams without any legible symbols. Emphasize the sturdy armor silhouette and decisive clear face. No helmet covering the face, no weapon across the face.
